description: This file implements server-side logic for managing recurring invoices in a frontend web application. It includes data loading, filtering, pagination, CRUD operations, and API integrations related to recurring invoices, built using SvelteKit.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Load function to fetch and process recurring invoices and account data from the backend API, applying filters, pagination, and transforming the response for frontend use.

methods.name: actions.create
methods.description: Handles creation of a new recurring invoice by collecting form data, formatting it, and sending a POST request to the backend API.

methods.name: actions.update
methods.description: Handles updating an existing recurring invoice with form data, sending a PUT request to the backend API.

methods.name: actions.delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of a recurring invoice via a DELETE API request.

methods.name: actions.toggle
methods.description: Toggles the active/inactive status of a recurring invoice through a POST API request.
